title: Valid Anagram
description: Check if two strings are anagrams using frequency counting.

data.text: Given `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an anagram of `s`.

data.title: Sorting O(n log n)
Fixed Array O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n log n) → O(n). **Space:** No dictionary overhead. Single loop processes both strings.
